title: Globe 3D
dotGlowHint: Bloom render passes while location dots are visible - disable to save GPU
dotsTrackRodHeightHint: Lifts location dots to ride their rod's current scanner/ripple/audio bump - costs a bit of extra GPU per dot
closeHeightGapsHint: Raised rods flare their tops outward so tall spikes visually cover the crack against shorter neighbors
audioReactiveHint: Runs continuous PipeWire capture + FFT - noticeably spikes GPU usage while enabled
missingPlugin: This feature needs the Congeries QtQuick3D plugin, which isn't installed on this system. See the README's 3D globe section.
